Are you a skilled Refrigeration Technician passionate about securing high-quality technical support?

Advansor is looking for an Aftersales Engineer to join an international team driven by climate action and delivering the best customer support.

We strive to design and produce the world’s best sustainable CO2 climate solutions. We know CO2 by heart, having gained rock-solid experience from designing and producing more than 20,000 racks.

We proudly share our expertise, best practices, and training with our customers through webinars, online training, and 2-day courses at our state-of-the-art training centre.

Your role

Working from our facilities in Brabrand, you will become part of our Aftersales Team. We handle support, warranty, training, and commissioning support of our sustainable CO2 refrigeration and heating systems. Technical Support is one of our core businesses, and your main responsibility will be securing high-quality support for our customers.

We support customers across Europe and LATAM, and the team is represented both at our HQ in Brabrand and locally in these regions.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Providing technical support via phone and email, guiding customers through optimization, fault diagnosis, and daily operations.

• Participating in our 24/7 support setup to ensure our customers always have a technical lifeline.

• Handling warranty claims efficiently and professionally.

• Collaborating across the organization to solve complex issues and deliver the best possible customer experience.

• Traveling approximately 25 days per year as part of our international support setup.

Your background

• You have a background as a Refrigeration Technician or hold similar experience.

• Knowledge about CO2 as a refrigerant is an advantage, but we will make sure you receive the proper training.

• You are quality-conscious, solution-oriented, and driven by a desire to share your knowledge with other technicians.

• You communicate clearly and professionally in English (our corporate language), both verbally and in writing. Additional language skills are an advantage.

We offer

As part of Team Advansor, you will get to work with more than 300 competent colleagues of more than 20 different nationalities and join us in our mission: to design and produce the world’s best sustainable climate solutions. You will become part of a highly ambitious company that values a good working environment, diversity, and teamwork.

Salary is decided based on your qualifications.

Please contact Martin Toft, Technical Support Manager, Aftersales at mto@advansor.com or by phone: +45 51 27 54 96 if you have any questions about the position or Advansor as a workplace.

Advansor is a part of Dover Corporation – please apply on Dover’s website:

Sustainable CO2 climate solutions

As a market-leading manufacturer, we have designed and produced more than 20,000 CO2 systems for sustainable commercial and industrial cooling and heating around the world since 2006.

Many people associate CO2 with global warming. We’re cool with that. Literally. Because CO2 is the most climate-friendly refrigerant: It is non-toxic, non-flammable and does not affect the ozone layer or harm our drinking water. That is why we are ’cool with CO2’.

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for onshore and offshore pipeline operation, inspection, engineering and integrity tasks as well as asset management of the Danish onshore and offshore pipelines and terminals bringing most of the Danish oil and gas into Denmark.

**Welcome to Asset Integrity

**You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

**Working at Ørsted

**In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

_Are you passionate about financial planning and analytics? Do you want to shape financial performance insights and facilitate strategic decision‑making for the world’s largest jewellery brand? … If so, then we have an exciting opportunity for you!

_**Help shape the financial future of one of the world’s most iconic brands!

**The Group FP&A function has ownership of managing and steering the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting towards CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As our new Senior FP&A Manager, you will lead Pandora’s long‑term planning process and provide the analysis our executive team relies on to make informed decisions. You will translate strategic priorities into clear financial insights, build a strong understanding of our value drivers, and help ensure that the company is set up for long‑term success. To succeed, you must bring a strong financial background, excellent analytical capabilities and the ability to collaborate effectively across a wide, global stakeholder landscape.

This role requires deep expertise in financial planning, reporting, and modelling, along with solid knowledge of cash flow and balance sheet mechanics. You should be able to manage multiple priorities independently and perform effectively in a fast‑paced, constantly evolving environment.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead the long‑term financial planning process across the PANDORA Group, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy and supporting the translation of strategic priorities into financial outcomes

• Conduct and interpret detailed financial analyses to help the organization understand deviations from long‑term plan.

• Develop robust financial models to simulate business scenarios, assess risks and opportunities, and support strategic decision-making

• Act as a strategic finance partner, helping shape financial targets and performance expectations across a wide range of stakeholder groups

• Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations and reports for executive leadership meetings, distilling complex financial information into clear, actionable insights

• Drive long‑term cash flow and balance sheet forecasting, ensuring alignment with overall financial plans and supporting capital allocation decisions

• Independently manage ad hoc strategic and financial analyses for senior stakeholders up to the CFO level, ensuring timely and accurate responses to critical business questions

**Required Skills

**

• Strong ability to understand complex ideas and simplify them

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under tight deadlines

• Ability to build high‑level financial models and scenarios

• Advanced Excel and solid financial modelling skills

• Experience with planning/reporting systems

• Strong written and verbal communication in English

**Required Experience

**

• 5-8+ years of experience in FP&A, commercial finance or finance transformation

• Experience working in a global or regional role

• Strong background in financial modelling, reporting, and scenario analysis

• Experience driving cross‑functional projects and process improvements

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

At Pandora, we believe that creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and reflecting societal diversity in our customer engagement is essential to delivering on our company purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We dedicate ourselves to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and diversity where everyone feels respected and valued

We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and you work on features and product decisions that matter to end users.

• Build on a system with real scale behind it. The event system spans 8 domains, exposes 20+ event types as webhooks, and powers 10 configurable alert types for our end users - currently ~20k active configurations triggering ~200k events every weekday. The team owns 8+ public APIs end to end, crucial for customers' day-to-day business.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll join a talkative team of experienced domain experts who love discussing technical topics.

• Grow with support. Scoped, well-defined assignments to start, senior colleagues pairing and reviewing your work, and shared ownership of keeping things running.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so what you build lands in production fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills who is at home on live production systems.

• Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular building and running your own services in a modern cloud-based microservice and event-driven architecture.

• You are comfortable working on live production systems with high data volumes and migration paths, keeping quality, observability, reliability, and performance in mind.

• You enjoy talking tech: you like discussing technical topics widely, learning, and listening in on topics not always directly related to your own tasks.

• You are motivated by incremental, high-quality delivery on products that are already live, bringing a fresh perspective that helps rework existing infrastructure where it is holding us back, and you treat the tools already in our platform as solid building blocks.

• Nice to have: Flink and stateful processing (or the willingness to learn it, since it is widely used here), relational databases, and Grafana and Prometheus, our “bread and butter”.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve, extend and run the live domains our team owns, including telemetry storage and APIs, the event system, and the alerting engine, without disrupting production.

• Build and run your own services, with migration paths when architecture or data formats need to change.

• Work closely with the internal teams building products on top of the platform you help shape.

• Keep the platform reliable and observable at high data volumes.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

Are you ready to lead Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits across the Nordics? Join our Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team as an experienced Pursuit Lead and head some of our largest and most complex pursuits from early positioning through proposal and client presentation.

About us

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

Join our diverse Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team and help shape Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits. We combine pursuit expertise, insight and creativity to develop compelling propositions that stand out with clients. Our open, supportive culture encourages knowledge-sharing, fresh thinking and innovative tools to improve how we work. You will have opportunities to grow professionally and personally, build relationships across Deloitte and help shape the team’s approach to strategic pursuits.

This role could be placed in either Copenhagen, Denmark or in Oslo, Norway.

What will be your role?

We are looking for an experienced Pursuit Lead to join our team. You will project manage some of Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits across the Nordics, leading the end-to-end pursuit process from pre-RFP planning through proposal development, client presentations and follow-up. Using strong project management skills, you will create structure, momentum and quality across complex pursuits, while working closely with pursuit leadership and multidisciplinary teams.

Beyond managing the process, you will, together with rest of the Sales Excellence team, bring a strategic mindset, helping teams develop compelling and differentiated propositions.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Leading the pursuit process: Drive the plan with the client service pursuit lead, set milestones and deliverables, track assignments, manage meetings and logistics, and mitigate risks to deliver high-quality submissions that meet client requirements.

• Developing the winning strategy: Work with the Pursuit team to shape compelling value propositions, winning messages and a differentiated strategy for each opportunity.

• Coordinating proposal and presentation development: Oversee documents, design and quality and risk reviews, ensuring consistent strategic messaging across all deliverables.

• Engaging stakeholders and governance: Align senior leaders, subject-matter experts, client service teams and other internal stakeholders; facilitate leadership and quality reviews; and coordinate quality and solutions reviews.

• Managing risks proactively: Identify content and knowledge gaps, identify risks and escalate issues when appropriate.

• Driving innovation and continuous improvement: Apply best practices and lessons from past pursuits and the wider network. Use AI and innovative tools to improve research, collaboration, content and quality, and support learning initiatives that strengthen Deloitte’s sales excellence capabilities.

Who are we looking for?

You are a structured and proactive pursuit professional who can work independently while enabling effective collaboration and momentum across diverse teams. You combine sound judgement and analytical thinking with strong interpersonal skills. You maintain composure, flexibility and attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

What you bring to the team:

• Strong project management skills: Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage complex workstreams and maintain excellent quality control over milestones and deliverables.

• Pursuit and proposal experience: At least three years of experience in pursuit and proposal development, preferably in B2B / Professional services sales. A former consulting client-service background combined with pursuit experience is an advantage.

• Stakeholder leadership: Experience collaborating with and building consensus among executive, management and delivery stakeholders, including the ability to navigate differing opinions constructively.

• Proactive and analytical mindset: A self-starting approach, strong analytical skills and the ability to identify gaps, challenges and risks before they affect delivery.

• Resilience and flexibility: Ability to work well under pressure, maintain composure and adapt to shifting priorities and deadlines.

• Team orientation and interpersonal skills: A collaborative working style and strong relationship-building skills that foster trust, alignment and effective teamwork across diverse stakeholders.

• Language skills: Proficient in written and spoken English. Knowledge of another Scandinavian language is a benefit.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What impact will your role make?

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

Do you want to be part of our team?

Please submit your CV and answer a few questions about your experience. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate has been identified.

The formal application deadline is December 1st, 2026.

Please do not hesitate to contact Karine Bergeron at kabergeron@deloitte.no if you have any questions about the position.

**As Consumer Analytics & Reporting Manager, you will turn large, complex consumer data into dashboards, reports and analysis that Consumer Care and regional teams can trust and act on. You will build the reporting engine behind consumer campaigns across digital media, NovoCare, WegovyCare and other DtP channels, with consistent KPIs and validated data. Your work helps teams see what drives results, optimise faster and engage people living with serious chronic diseases in more relevant ways.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• A Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, marketing, business or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

• Relevant experience in consumer or marketing analytics.

• Experience delivering technical projects, including estimating development, managing dependencies, reviewing deliverables, and driving rollout and adoption.

• Experience with recurring performance reporting across diverse data sources.

• The ability to assess data quality and measurement limitations, distinguish correlation from causation and turn findings into testable recommendations.

• Good change management skills, including driving adoption of new tools, workflows and capabilities across diverse teams.

• An understanding of privacy, consent and promotional review considerations when using consumer engagement data.

• A structured, curious and commercially minded approach, with the ability to explain evidence, uncertainty and actions in plain language.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience in FMCG.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be the hands-on link between consumer strategy and the data that shows whether it is working. For some projects you will build and model the data yourself; for others you will lead the collaboration with platform teams to get the right data in place.

• Partner with Consumer Care and regional teams to understand what success looks like for consumer engagement, and turn it into practical analytics and reporting.

• Build, maintain and improve consumer analytics solutions, such as dashboards or agents, and act as the Consumer Care super user.

• Establish a reliable reporting engine with unified KPI and metric definitions, clean and documented data, and recurring business reports covering journeys and campaigns across digital media, NovoCare, WegovyCare, partner sites and other DtP channels.

• Agree campaign objectives, KPIs, benchmarks and reporting cadence with campaign owners at activation, and specify data, tagging and tracking requirements with platform and data owners.

• Validate results, investigate discrepancies, troubleshoot issues and manage access, so reports truthfully display results.

• Track brand health and social conversation, assess what drives results across audiences, messages and touchpoints, and lead insight review sessions that turn findings into campaign optimisation and prioritised actions.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Consumer Care, Content & Media in International Operations, reporting to Alejandra Betancourt, Content Associate Vice President. In International Operations, colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale.

Your closest partners will be the Consumer Care team and global and regional consumer teams, who you will help turn strategy into measurement plans and reporting. You will also work with Enterprise AI, platform and data owners, and the teams responsible for our CDP data foundation to enable data access, pipelines and tracking. Stakeholder feedback will help shape the priorities and roadmap of the Engagement Intelligence team.

Your scope is global, primarily excluding the US and China, with reporting and insight support for relevant regions and affiliates. You will adapt analyses to local channel availability, market context and applicable requirements, always in alignment with regional representatives.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued and your voice is heard. You will be trusted to take ownership of the quality and reliability of consumer analytics, supported by colleagues across Consumer Care, regional teams, Enterprise AI and platform teams. Working across functions and markets gives you the opportunity to build new skills, broaden your perspective and see your work adopted by teams who rely on it.

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insight they need to make better financial decisions. All connected directly to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

Our platform has grown with us. The infrastructure that keeps Skatteguiden running has reached a scale and complexity that deserves full-time, specialist ownership, and the work ahead makes this an unusually good time to join.

About the role

You'll be joining the Platform team as a Platform Application Engineer, the counterpart to our Operational Platform team, which owns the infrastructure. Where they own the systems that keep Skatteguiden running, you'll own the shared application-layer services that the rest of engineering depends on.

The team treats these services as a product, with engineers distributed across several product teams as their users. Every product team touches payments, identity, and integrations. Your job is to make those services reliable, well-designed, and genuinely easy to build on, across a microservices architecture that favours low coupling and event-driven communication over direct dependencies.

We operate on a simple principle: you build it, you own it. That means end-to-end accountability, from design and implementation through to what happens when something goes wrong. Incidents aren't escalated to someone else's queue; they're yours to understand, resolve, and learn from.

What you'll do

Own the shared application platform. Design and build the core backend services underpinning payments, identity, authorisation, and third-party integrations — the shared foundation that product teams rely on every day.

Build and maintain payment services. Design payment flows that are reliable, observable, and compliant. Work with product teams to support new features and providers without coupling concerns or creating fragility in the critical path.

Own identity and authorisation. Design the systems that manage who our users are and what they can do — from OAuth flows and token management to fine-grained permission models and audit trails.

Integrate security and privacy into the application layer. Work with our Head of Security & Privacy to translate requirements into technical controls — particularly in identity, authorisation, and data handling — with GDPR and ISO 27001 in mind.

Integrate third-party systems. Own the integration layer connecting messaging, payment providers, and others. Ensure resilience, observability, and clear contracts.

Improve the developer experience. Build shared libraries, abstractions, and internal tooling that make it easier for product engineers to build on top of platform services correctly and confidently. Reduce the cognitive load on teams that shouldn't need to think about auth or payment internals.

Who we're looking for

You're likely a senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, and who sees that role not just as backend development but as a product discipline — with the engineers who depend on your services as your primary users.

You take end-to-end ownership seriously. You don't consider something done when the code is merged, you care about how it behaves in production, you're on the hook when it doesn't, and you treat incidents as feedback worth acting on.

You're genuinely collaborative, someone who makes the people around them better, shares context freely, and doesn't work in isolation. And you're curious: you like trying new things, you're not attached to the way things have always been done, and you get energy from learning.

Must-have

A senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, writes clean, maintainable services, takes API design seriously, and cares about the boundaries between components.

Hands-on experience deploying and debugging services on Kubernetes in production; you know how to get code running reliably in a Kubernetes environment without needing to own the cluster.

Experience designing MySQL schemas for production, migrations, indexing, query performance, and keeping data models clean as requirements evolve.

Working knowledge of message brokers such as RabbitMQ, event-driven patterns, consumer reliability, and how to design async communication that is easy to reason about across a distributed codebase.

Understanding of identity and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC), and how to implement them securely and maintainably at scale.

Security, privacy, and compliance awareness. You design with GDPR, auditability, and least-privilege access in mind from the start, not as an afterthought.

A platform-as-a-product mindset. Experience thinking about developer experience as a product discipline, not just an engineering concern.

Genuine enthusiasm for AI. You use it daily, and you're always looking for new ways to apply it.

Nice-to-have

Experience building or operating payment integrations — familiarity with PSPs, webhook reliability, idempotency, and reconciliation.

Familiarity with React and TypeScript — enough to read, understand, and occasionally contribute to frontend code when the work calls for it.

Familiarity with Azure. You know your way around the platform — how services connect, how access and permissions work, and how to build in a cloud-native context.

Familiarity with our observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry.

Familiarity with our GitOps tooling: ArgoCD and GitHub Actions.

Why join us

A substantial project from day one. The hosting migration means designing a production system from scratch, rare at any company.

Real influence. The architectural decisions made in this team will shape how Skatteguiden is built and operated for years. It's a small team with a high degree of autonomy, and the work is genuinely consequential.

Strong engineering culture. We take the technical foundations seriously. Security, architecture, and technical debt get real attention, not just lip service.

The product matters. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden. Your work keeps it running and makes it possible to grow.

Solid company. We're independent, profitable, and growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

A company that's serious about AI. We use AI across the business and we're only going deeper. Being a small, focused team means we can move fast on this, no lengthy approval chains, no slow rollouts. If you're always looking for ways to work smarter with AI, you'll fit right in.

Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone. We want to be upfront about this so you know what to expect.

And if we're asking people to be in the office, we want it to be worth their while. We're a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen, stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks, and lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street, proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: CTO

Our lean hiring process

Screening call with our recruiter (30 min) ONLINE

Technical interview with the manager and an engineer (120 min) ONSITE

Meeting with our CEO (15 min) ONSITE

Our operations team is looking for a Property Manager who is tired of the status quo. You will partner closely with our software engineers to shape the future of our platform. You’ll have the opportunity to span the entire process, from managing complex portfolios and advising landlords to deciding which manual tasks our engineers should automate next.

Do you spend your entire day in UNIK or EG Bolig on stuff and wonder if it could be automated and taken care of by robots? We want to change that. Right now is the best time to join because you’ll get the chance to shape your own role and help us enter new markets across the Nordics.

****What we do

****Property management is fundamentally broken. It’s held back by 90s software and linear scaling: more tenants equals more manual work.

We automate high-volume, low-value tasks like bank reconciliation, debt collection, and legal notices to strip human error and bureaucracy out of the rental experience. By removing the friction, we allow landlords and tenants to actually communicate, putting the human connection back at the centre of the business.

Proper is a seal of quality and trust in a messy market. After years of scaling our software to thousands of users, we are now rebuilding our entire stack from the ground up with AI as the foundation. We are moving from being a software provider to a full-service property operator. We’re not just building the platform; we’re running it.

****You will

• Be a core part of the team: Work closely with software engineers and product designers to shape our product with your domain expertise.

• Own the portfolio: Manage the daily administration, including lease contracts, rent adjustments, compliance, and maintenance.

• Bridge the gap: Identify the friction points in your daily work and help the product team decide on what to build next.

• Be the expert: Act as the primary advisor for landlords on the complex side of property: legislation, strategy, and finance.

• Operate at scale: Pilot our automated systems to manage a portfolio size that would be impossible at a traditional firm.

****You may be a fit if you are

• From the field: You have a minimum of 2 years experience in property management and actually enjoy solving the puzzles of the Danish Rental Act.

• Done with legacy tech: You’ve used the old systems and you know they suck. You probably already have ideas on how to fix them.

• A "product" thinker: You don’t just want to follow a checklist; you want to build a better system.

• Numbers don’t scare you: You’re comfortable with budgets, utility accounts, and tools like Visma e-conomic.

• Equipped with an entrepreneurial mindset: You’re comfortable assuming ownership and working in a fast-paced startup environment

• Bilingual: You are fluent in Danish for legal documents and English for our office culture.

**What You’ll Get

**Almost everyone lives or works in a building someone else looks after, and how that is done has barely changed in decades. Rumli is rethinking it – and you'll be part of the team making it happen, backed by some of Denmark's leading investors. The distance from idea to action here is short, and impact gets noticed fast.

• Ownership of the company through our warrant program.

• An office in the heart of Copenhagen, two minutes from Kongens Nytorv.

• Daily lunch, drinks and snacks at the office.

• Private health insurance.

• 30 days of paid holiday.

We're looking for people, not bullet points on a CV. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. If this sounds like you and you want to build something that matters with people who care, we'd love to hear from you.

**World leader in allergy

**ALK is a global specialty pharmaceutical company based in Denmark, dedicated to allergy treatment and innovation for over a century. Present in 46 markets with production sites in the USA, Spain, France, and Denmark, we reach 3.1 million patients annually and aim to help 5 million people living with allergies by 2030.

Our 2,800 employees support this mission, with Global IT enabling modern technologies and world-class support across the organization.

We are looking for an IT Supporter to provide reliable, friendly technical assistance to colleagues and help keep workplace technology running smoothly. You will respond to support requests, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, and contribute to the effective day-to-day operation of IT services.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Resolve incidents and requests from colleagues by phone, email, ServiceNow and in person

• Set up and maintain laptops, mobile devices, printers, accounts and software

• Prepare equipment and access for onboarding and offboarding

• Document your work in ServiceNow and escalate complex or recurring issues to the right team

• Support IT asset management and routine maintenance

• Maintain GxP documentation for your area and support production-site IT when needed

**What You Bring

**

• At least 3 years’ hands-on experience in IT support or service desk in a Microsoft environment

• Solid working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365 and [Entra ID / Intune]

• Experience working independently and prioritising your own queue

• Experience with an ITSM tool (ServiceNow is a plus)

• Fluent Danish and English

Nice to have: ITIL Foundation, experience in a regulated (GxP) environment, basic networking

**What We Offer

**

• A close local team of three colleagues, plus a European support network

• Reporting to the Senior Manager, IT Support Europe

• Opportunities to grow within Global IT

**Become a part of ALK

**ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision-making process. We consider our pioneering spirit, coupled with our trustworthiness, our winning formula.

Join us at ALK and be a part of an organization that values integrity, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve.

Allergy impacts and challenges the lives of millions of adults and children every day. At ALK, our purpose is to improve the lives of people living with allergies. Building on our strong heritage, we are guided by our strategy, Allergy+, that shows us a clear path towards this goal through focus, innovation, cultivation and optimisation.

jobs.description:
Manager, Skilled Workers – Packaging & Filling Line Maintenance

**Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Are you an experienced leader with a strong understanding of manufacturing operations and a passion for developing skilled technical employees?

Do you thrive in an operational environment where people leadership, equipment reliability and continuous improvement are equally important?

Are you ready to take responsibility for a skilled maintenance team and help strengthen operational performance within HRT Packaging?

If so, we would like to hear from you.

**The Position

**As Manager, Skilled Workers within HRT Packaging, you will lead a team of skilled maintenance employees responsible for supporting the reliability and performance of packaging and filling equipment at our Måløv site.

This is an operational leadership position requiring someone who understands the realities of a production environment and has already demonstrated the ability to lead technical employees.

You will have the opportunity to shape how the team operates, develop the capabilities of experienced technical employees and contribute directly to the department's operational performance.

Working closely with Production and other technical functions, you will balance immediate operational requirements with longer term maintenance improvements, ensuring your team has the direction, structure and support needed to succeed.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading, coaching and developing skilled maintenance employees, establishing clear expectations, accountability and continuous development.

• Managing daily maintenance priorities, resources and team performance to support reliable production.

• Ensuring effective preventive and corrective maintenance to improve equipment reliability and minimise downtime.

• Using maintenance data, KPIs and performance trends to identify opportunities and make informed operational decisions.

• Supporting structured problem-solving and addressing recurring equipment issues.

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen equipment reliability and operational efficiency.

• Building effective working relationships with Production, Quality, Engineering and other relevant stakeholders.

• Ensuring maintenance activities comply with GMP, safety and quality requirements.Creating a positive, collaborative and performance focused team culture.

**Qualifications

**We are looking for an experienced operational leader who understands both the technical and people-related challenges of managing skilled employees within a manufacturing environment.

**To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:

**

• Proven experience leading skilled technical employees within a manufacturing environment, including responsibility for team performance, employee development and day-to-day operational delivery.

• Demonstrable experience managing or formally supervising employees within maintenance, engineering, production or a comparable technical function.

• Practical experience coaching employees, addressing performance challenges and handling difficult leadership situations.

• A sound understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance, equipment reliability and manufacturing operations.

• Experience using operational data or performance indicators to support decisions and drive improvements.

• Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder-management skills.

• A structured approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.

• Fluency in Danish and English.

• Experience within pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP regulated operations, packaging equipment or filling processes would be advantageous.

• We also welcome applications from experienced supervisors and team leaders who have already demonstrated meaningful people leadership and are ready to take on broader management responsibility.

• About YouYou are a confident, visible and approachable leader who enjoys working closely with skilled technical employees.

• You understand that effective leadership requires more than technical knowledge. You can set clear expectations, address performance challenges, coach employees and create an environment where people take ownership of their work.

• You are comfortable making decisions in a busy production environment, using data and operational insights to establish priorities.

• You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively and can constructively challenge stakeholders when necessary.

• Above all, you bring the maturity, accountability and practical leadership experience needed to develop a team while maintaining operational performance.

**About The Department

**You will join HRT Packaging at our Måløv site, part of Novo's manufacturing organisation.

The department is responsible for packaging hormone replacement therapy products, contributing to the delivery of medicines that make a meaningful difference to patients.

Our maintenance teams play an essential role in ensuring that production equipment operates safely, efficiently and reliably.

With increasing production demands, we are continuing to strengthen our maintenance capabilities, equipment performance and ways of working.

As Manager, Skilled Workers, you will have the opportunity to influence how the team develops and contributes to the department's future success.

**Why Novo

**At Novo, your skills, dedication and ambition help us change lives for the better.

In return, we offer an opportunity to work alongside talented colleagues, take on meaningful responsibilities and continue developing professionally and personally.

Working at NovoAt Novo,

we don't wait for change. We drive it.

We're a dynamic company in an even more dynamic industry, and we know that what got us to where we are today is not necessarily what will make us successful in the future.

We embrace the spirit of experimentation, striving for excellence without fixating on perfection. We never shy away from opportunities to develop; we seize them.

From research and development to manufacturing, marketing and sales, we're all working to move the needle on patient care.

**Salary And Benefits

**The salary range for this position is DKK 651,000 to 956,900 annually.

The final salary will depend on the candidate's qualifications, experience and applicable employment conditions.

**Incentives And Benefits

**At Novo, we offer a competitive remuneration package and a range of benefits designed to support our employees' professional and personal wellbeing.

Applicable benefits and incentive arrangements will be discussed as part of the recruitment process.

**What We Offer

**There is nothing ordinary about working at Novo.

Our purpose is to drive change to defeat serious chronic diseases, building upon our heritage in diabetes.

We do so by pioneering scientific breakthroughs, expanding access to our medicines and working to prevent and ultimately cure disease.

We offer an inclusive and collaborative working environment where employees can develop their capabilities, contribute their ideas and make a meaningful difference.

**Inclusive Recruitment

**We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo, we recognise that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to be the best company for the world, and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures.

We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and the communities in which we operate.

Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Department: RevOps

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird is a manufacturing intelligence suite that turns real-time production data into actionable insights. Our plug-and-play hardware and AI-powered SaaS solution help manufacturers cut downtime, improve efficiency and reduce waste. We are around 100 people across Europe and the US, growing more than 50% year over year. We have just partnered with the private equity firm Verdane to strengthen our product roadmap and expand our reach even further.

We have built a solid Revenue Operations foundation, with HubSpot as our CRM, BigQuery as our data warehouse, and Power BI and Claude for reporting that the leadership team and the board rely on. Now we want to take the next step. We are looking for a Revenue Operations Manager who doesn't just keep the engine running, but tells us where to steer it.

This is a role for someone who looks at our numbers and asks "so what?" Which segments should we double down on? Where is the funnel leaking? Which investments will pay back? What can we do even better? You will help answer those questions and make sure the answers lead to action.

**The role

**You will own Revenue Operations across the full customer journey, from the first marketing touch to sales, onboarding, renewal, and expansion. Your job is to unify the processes, technology, and data behind our revenue teams so that growth becomes more predictable, transparent, and scalable.

You will be based at our office at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, report to the CFO, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and the senior leadership team. You will lead our Business Intelligence Analyst, who owns the data warehouse, the data pipelines, and the Power BI dashboards.

You will thrive here if you combine a commercial mindset with analytical rigor, and you enjoy turning a messy question into a clear recommendation that a leadership team can act on.

**What You'll Do

**Planning and GTM

• Turn performance, customer, and market data into clear recommendations: where to invest, which segments and industries to prioritize, and what isn't working.

• Support commercial planning with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, including targets, quotas, and capacity planning.

• Support sales leadership on territory design, lead routing, and pipeline coverage.

Data and Intelligence

• Develop the commercial KPIs that matter across the funnel, such as pipeline, conversion, win rates, CAC, churn, and net revenue retention, and understand the data behind it.

• Own the monthly commercial performance reporting for the leadership team and present the story and learnings behind the numbers.

• Lead deep-dive analyses, such as ICP and industry performance, win/loss and churn drivers, and recommend corrective actions.

• Lead and develop our Business Intelligence Analyst: set priorities, goals, and development plans.

Best in Class Processes

• Map our processes from lead to renewal, find the bottlenecks, and fix them together with Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

• Design workflows and hand-offs that cut admin time and improve data quality for Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

Technology and AI

• Foster the adoption of AI across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success: connect AI assistants to our CRM and data, and build AI-powered workflows for enrichment, lead scoring and reporting. AI-powered tools in our current stack include Gong, Amplemarket, Claude and Dreamdata.

• Measure the impact of AI and automation on productivity and pipeline.

Revenue Funnel Pursuit

• Give the revenue teams the insights, tools and cadences they need at every stage of the funnel, from demand generation to renewal and expansion.

• Support Marketing on attribution, intent data and campaign reporting.

• Support Customer Success with health, churn-risk and expansion insights.

Project Management

• Plan and deliver cross-functional revenue projects from scope to measurable impact.

• Lead the change management that comes with new processes and tools, so they stick.

**What We're Looking For

**We are looking for a commercially minded problem solver who uses data to drive decisions and create value. You understand what drives growth in a B2B business, you are comfortable in front of a leadership team, and you are hands-on enough to get into HubSpot yourself.

The ideal background

• 5 to 7 years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, commercial analytics, strategy or management consulting, or a similar role.

• Experience from a B2B SaaS or tech scale-up, where you have seen what drives growth up close.

• A proven track record of turning data into insights and recommendations that leaders acted on.

• Strong analytical skills: you may have been a Business Intelligence Analyst in the past. You are definitely at home with funnel metrics, unit economics and forecasting, and you can build a model in Excel or a BI tool.

• Solid HubSpot experience and you will need to be confident as its Super Admin.

• Curiosity about AI, and practical experience using it to automate work or get more out of data.

• Clear communication in English, written and spoken, at leadership and board level.

How you work

• You think like a business owner and always ask what a number means for growth.

• You work autonomously, take ownership, and see what could be better before anyone asks. You help the teams around you turn those ideas into real improvements.

• You build trust across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, and you can challenge with facts.

• You enjoy coaching others and want to develop the analyst on your team.

• You like structure, but you are happy to build it where it doesn't exist yet.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams - and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here’s what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

**_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

__We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The opportunity

**The Clients & Industries (C&I) Revenue Planning Lead will have overall global oversight and leadership of the Global C&I Revenue Planning Team within the Enablement & Technology domain. The role will team closely with Global and Region Clients & Industries Leadership and domains on cross-functional initiatives and translate EY’s strategic priorities into the revenue planning business process.

The role will lead the continued evolution of global sales and revenue planning, strengthening the processes, governance and capabilities that connect account-level growth ambitions with regional and global business priorities. Working across markets, service lines and strategic growth areas, the role will help translate growth ambitions into actionable sales and revenue plans, focusing on topline growth, where and how the business will grow. It does not own P&L, financial forecasting, budgeting or expense planning, which remain Finance responsibilities.

Serve as the primary relationship lead to Global and Region leadership, connecting sales and revenue planning priorities with broader business objectives, enabling alignment, strengthening adoption, and accelerating decisions.

This includes active management of all sales and revenue planning business processes globally, aligned to and informed by evolving business needs. The role will collaborate with teams to identify and enable opportunities to use AI and advanced technologies to improve planning effectiveness, decision support, process efficiency and user adoption across the revenue planning lifecycle. The role will also have a hands-on delivery role across the range of sales and revenue planning activities.

The role will be responsible for performance management of the Revenue Planning Team, including LEAD counselor responsibilities and the integration of GDS resource capability.

As a key member of the Enablement & Technology domain, the role will collaborate on a broader set of Global Clients & Industries priorities and may act as sponsor for agreed strategic initiatives.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**Some or all the below will be applicable depending on the scope and team alignment of the role.

• 
Sales & Revenue Planning

• 
Continue to build, refine, and manage sales and revenue planning

• 
Implement and maintain consistency of sales and revenue planning governance globally

• 
Establish trusted, long-term relationships with senior leaders to understand their priorities and translate them into coordinated revenue planning actions

• 
Shape and sustain strategic stakeholder alignment across Regions, Service Lines, Growth & Innovation, Industry, and Client Excellence, providing strategic leadership and influence to align cross-functional priorities to enable a consistent global revenue planning process

• 
Participate in and contribute to efforts to ensure consistency of integrated planning processes and protocols across Clients & Industries, Finance, Regions, Services Lines, Growth & Innovation, and IT

• 
Process improvement

• 
Guide the evolution of revenue planning toward a process to enhance strategic decision- making

• 
Collaborate with Finance to identify relevant, consistent revenue planning, analysis for senior stakeholders (i.e., GE, GPG, GMIC, Clients & Industries Leadership)

• 
Operationalize and implement on a consistent basis; identify trends and issues and present recommendations as warranted

• 
Leverage AI and advanced technologies to streamline revenue planning processes, improve data quality and insight generation, and increase efficiency, accuracy and decision support

• 
Effective teaming

• 
Deliver inclusive and trusted leadership and coaching at all levels to ensure all Revenue Planning team members achieve their highest potential both individually and collectively

• 
Manage, mentor and counsel Revenue Planning team members, as appropriate

• 
Leverage and elevate GDS resource capability across the Clients & Industries revenue planning landscape

• 
Manage Clients & Industries and other EY stakeholder relationships - Clients & Industries pillar leaders, Finance, Regions, Service Lines, Growth & Innovation - and identify opportunities for effective collaboration

• 
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:

• 
Apply in-depth knowledge of the business and resources, leveraging relationships, communications and operational effectiveness to anticipate, drive and deliver complex revenue planning

• 
Provide strategic revenue planning insight and guidance to leadership

• 
Possess a high level of complex, conceptual problem-solving ability

• 
Convert planning data or abstract concepts into sharp, compelling management information reporting

• 
Create and implement timelines related to project deliverables, assign tasks, drive their completion and manage sponsor/stakeholder expectations of the outcomes

• 
Manage highly complex relationships with multiple stakeholders

• 
Make decisions regarding project resource and funding needs

• 
Supervision Responsibilities:

• 
Lead, coach and develop the Revenue Planning team

• 
Develop a culture of success by leading and driving the execution of high-performing, diverse and inclusive talent management (hiring, developing, assessing, etc)

• 
LEAD Reviewer responsibilities and provision of mentoring and regular feedback

• 
Develop and maintain metrics on team performance, providing regular feedback in LEAD and publicizing the teams’ contributions to leadership and other relevant stakeholders

• 
Instil high performing teaming principles

• 
Operate with high degree of independency and autonomy

**Skills And Attributes For Success

**

• In-depth knowledge of the EY business and working in a global partnership

• Strong influencing and consensus-building capability in a complex, matrixed organization where success depends on partnership rather than direct authority

• Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility quickly across functions, geographies, and leadership levels

• Experience in large transformation programs within a global environment and/or successfully transforming business functions. This includes demonstrated change leadership skills around disruption and increasing business agility, innovation and adoption

• High level of complex, conceptual problem-solving ability, a wide sphere of influence and a broad-based network are expected

• Financial acumen with demonstrable ability to analyze business reporting and develop business insights

• Demonstrates technology acumen, comfortable with AI and automation

• Proven track record of leading global virtual teams

• Demonstrated drive, determination and resilience, and track record of being able to overcome barriers and achieve results

• Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written) with a global mindset and ability to communicate and work effectively across culture

• Understanding of and desire to strive for technical excellence and commercial impact

• Demonstrated experience working at a senior level in a fast-moving, client-driven environment

• Strong executive presence and ability to build and sustain stakeholder relationships at the highest levels of the firm with the ability to quickly establish personal credibility and influence

• Resilient, agile, and pragmatic under pressure

**To qualify for the role, you must have:

**

• Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent qualification required

• 10-12 years of experience leading complex, large-scale transformation initiatives, preferably within sales, commercial, finance or enterprise planning functions.

**Ideally, you should also be prepared for the following:

**

• Travel may be required from time to time to complete assignments and meet with organizational leaders and stakeholders

• Flexibility in working hours to accommodate volume of work and multiple time zones as needed

**What We Offer You

**The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges.At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

• We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $129,500 to $249,200. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $155,300 to $283,200. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

• Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.

You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

Every year, European governments spend billions on mobility: subsidies, contracts, licences, public transport. Most of that money is spent with no clear idea of what it buys for society.

We're building the tech layer that changes that.

**What We Do

**Impact Market builds MIMA, the Mobility Impact Market. On our platform, cities and transport authorities incentivise mobility operators (bike share, e-scooters, car-pooling, car sharing, bike leasing) for trips according to their benefit to society: a car trip replaced, emissions avoided, space and congestion saved, health improved, a neighbourhood connected. By estimating the socio-economic impact of each trip, we design smart incentives that get the most social value out of public funds.

The idea is much bigger than mobility: governments paying for the outcomes they want, with the evidence to back it up. Mobility is our first market, and we intend to move into other areas of public spending.

**Where we are

**

• Funded with 12+ months runway

• Several paying public-sector clients

• A production platform (prod + staging), with live trip and rider-survey data from operators flowing in since August 2026

• A team of 3. You'd be number 4.

**The role

**You'll be our first technical hire and will lead product and engineering. For now that means hands fully dirty: you write the code. No agencies, no outsourcing.

• Own the platform. Rust, Postgres, cloud, our RiderSurvey API, and the data pipelines from operators. You'll inherit a working MVP and decide what to keep, what to rebuild and what to build next.

• Make the big calls, including the language. We chose Rust deliberately: we think a strict compiler and type system are the right guardrails for building fast with AI. If you have a better argument for something else, convince us.

• Be AI-native. We expect you to use AI seriously in coding and every other technical task. That's how a team of four does the work of fifteen.

• Build agents that run the company with us, for account management, client reporting and forecasting.

• Grow into the science. Together with a future R&D lead, you'll work on the statistical significance of measured impacts and on forecasting how markets respond to incentives.

• Shape the product with the founders and our clients. You'll be in the room with transport authorities, not behind a ticket queue.

**You

**

• Have minimum 4 years of relevant experience shipping production software, ideally backend or data-heavy systems

• Senior and still love writing code every day? Even better.

• Know Rust, or are genuinely motivated to go deep in it (not just "willing"). (We are not dogmatic about Rust, but we have a working platform built with care, so changing direction would take strong conviction.)

• Already build with AI tools daily and have opinions about how to do it well

• Are comfortable with data: SQL, pipelines, and an appetite for statistics and forecasting

• Take ownership when things are ambiguous, and like it when nobody tells you how

• Care about the mission. You don't need to have read our founder's book, The Next Democracy, but its core ideas about how citizens and governments could work together - is fundamental to what we do. If they don’t excite you, this probably isn’t the right fit.

Bonus points for experience in mobility or transport, govtech, causal inference or experimentation, or privacy-by-design and GDPR.

**What We Offer

**

• A real say in everything. Stack, product, architecture, culture and who we hire next.

• Title decided together. We're advertising this as CTO / Founding Engineer and will settle the title with you based on your experience and ambitions.

• Competitive startup salary plus a meaningful warrant package, designed to make total compensation comparable with bigger-company offers

• 5 weeks of holiday and flexible hours

• Work that matters. Help redirect public money towards what actually improves people's lives.

**Location

**Copenhagen is our home, and we'd love you here; relocation is very welcome. If you stay elsewhere, you must be based in the EU and work in EU time zones. You'd spend your first 1–2 months with us in Copenhagen, then 2–4 days here every month after that.

**Process

**

• Quick online intro call with Erdem (CEO)

• In-person meeting

• A challenge based on a real problem from our platform

• Second meeting with the team

• Offer
